_comment: Customer context for metadata generation -- JSON equivalent of customer_context.yaml.
Upload this from the app (Customer Context > Upload File) or seed it the same way as the
YAML form. Entries are injected into the LLM prompt for every matching table so generated
Each entry: scope (identifier to match), scope_type (catalog|schema|table|pattern),
context_text (<= 500 words), context_label (optional), priority (optional int, lower sorts
first). More specific scopes win: table > pattern > schema > catalog. The top-level shape is
either this object with a 'contexts' list, or a bare JSON array of the entries.

contexts.context_text: This schema is an investment-operations warehouse. "Position" means a portfolio holding (a security a fund owns), NOT a job role or GPS location. "Book" refers to a trading book. Amounts are in USD unless a currency column says otherwise.
Tables prefixed fct_ are fact tables at transaction grain; each row is one trade. Treat *_amt columns as monetary measures and *_dt as event dates.
One row per client account. account_status uses codes A=active, C=closed, S=suspended. Do NOT treat ssn_hash as a real SSN -- it is a salted hash used only for joins.
